summary: Inflection Point Acquisition Corp. V (SPAC) filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to its Business Combination Agreement with GOWell Technology. The July 13, 2026 amendment modifies earnout EBITDA targets: partial earnout at 80% achievement of 2026 target (mirroring 2027/2028 structure) and increases the SPAC transaction expense cap from $8M to $9M with carveouts. No price per share or premium stated. The board earlier entered the agreement; no new recommendation. The amendment fine-tunes deal mechanics ahead of closing. Watch for shareholder vote and any further adjustments; risk-arb centers on deal completion timeline.
